nodes.label: Sinhala Only Act (1956)
nodes.subject: polity
nodes.detail: Sri Lankan law recognising Sinhala as the only official language, disregarding Tamil. A key majoritarian measure that increased alienation among Tamil minority and contributed to ethnic tensions leading to civil war.

nodes.label: Communal Violence
nodes.subject: polity
nodes.detail: Extreme manifestation of communalism. India has experienced periodic communal riots. Constitution and secular laws aim to prevent it. Independent judiciary and human rights commissions provide remedies. Yet communal tensions remain a challenge to Indian democracy.
